human faces, & hearing voices’ (L ii 292). However, the singing habits of the ‘aziola’ allow

support of a June–July date, it is worth noting that Nora Crook and B. C. Barker-Benfield

paper used in those months for a ‘rough transcript’ of Valperga and for Edward Williams’s
draft of Act IV of The Promise; or, A year, a month, and a day (MSW iii 328; BSM xxiii 82).
